description: Domain-neutral model governance policy for stage-bound model selection, multimodal capabilities, validation, cost control, on-demand installation, fallback, escalation, and recommendation intake.
governance_principles: Runtime stages choose models through policy, not through ad-hoc prompt decisions.
Deterministic taxonomy, registry, parser, and validator components are preferred before LLM proposals.
LLMs may propose candidates; runtime policy, schema validation, benchmarks, and operator preferences decide acceptance.
Weak or low-tier models must not directly consume complex raw evidence for final synthesis.
Every stage must declare validation, fallback, escalation, downgrade, cost, and privacy behavior.
Business or domain-specific keywords are forbidden in this policy. Capabilities are generic and modality-based.

runtime_cost_policy.notes: Domain-neutral runtime budget and convergence controls.
